power.requirements: Use the camera's original 5V/1A USB adapter and 2m USB-C cable. The separate HomeBase Mini adapter is 5V/2A, not the camera adapter. Confirm safe weather-protected supply, cable reach and the exact SKU/manual; an outlet alone is not proof of compatibility. Not a PoE or mains-hardwired camera.

solar.notes: This standard uses continuous USB-C adapter power; no solar conversion is standardized.

wifi.notes: Camera Wi-Fi is 2.4GHz. Do not infer camera 5GHz support from HomeBase router connectivity.

storage.notes: No built-in storage. Local microSD sold separately, formatted in the app; HomeBase is an alternative, not included in the single-camera SKU. Not HomeBase 2 or HomeKit compatible. No cloud subscription cost is assumed.

requirements: Confirm exact single-camera SKU, adapter label, cable and box contents; the manual also illustrates optional HomeBase kits.

Test 2.4GHz coverage, mounting surface, recording media and installation complexity.
verification.notes: Official product specifications and manufacturer-manual text mirrored by ManualsLib distinguish the camera adapter from HomeBase power. IP66 and 1080p are official product specifications. Verify purchased variant before procurement.
